description: This is a shell script used for testing the 'git show' command within a git repository workflow. It sets up various scenarios to verify the behavior of 'git show' with different options, references, and object types.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a setup phase and a command to verify, expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge operation in the test repository.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or variables.
